HERO.SUBTITLE: Manage the entire employee lifecycle in one connected system, from attendance to payroll.

UI_INTEGRATED.SECTION_SUBTITLE: Select the area you want to view. Every process connects to the same data and is always traceable.

FLOATING_BADGE.SUBTITLE: Centralized employee data in one system

HERO_COPY.DESCRIPTION: From attendance to payroll and employee management, PISICloud helps simplify administrative processes through an integrated system

FEATURE.SUBTITLE: Interconnected capabilities to streamline HR operations and deliver consistent management insights.

ATTENDANCE_MACHINE.TITLE: Attendance Machine & Biometrics
ATTENDANCE_MACHINE.DESC: Direct integration with fingerprint, face recognition, and RFID machines for automated real-time attendance syncing.

ATTENDANCE.TITLE: Attendance & Shift Management
ATTENDANCE.DESC: Monitor employee attendance, configure flexible work schedules, multi-shift rosters, and track daily working hours accurately.

COLLECTIVE_LEAVE.TITLE: Collective Leave Management
COLLECTIVE_LEAVE.DESC: Manage national holidays and collective company leave with automatic deduction and adjustment of annual leave quotas.

PERSONAL_LEAVE.TITLE: Personal Leave & Balance
PERSONAL_LEAVE.DESC: Submit annual, sick, and special leave requests online with multi-level approval workflows and automated balance tracking.

PERSONAL_ATTENDANCE.TITLE: Mobile Self-Clocking & GPS
PERSONAL_ATTENDANCE.DESC: Convenient mobile attendance for remote and field employees with GPS geolocation and anti-fraud selfie verification.

RECRUITMENT.TITLE: Recruitment & Onboarding
RECRUITMENT.DESC: End-to-end recruitment management from job postings, candidate screening, and interview scheduling to new hire onboarding.

COLLECTIVE_OVERTIME.TITLE: Collective Overtime Orders
COLLECTIVE_OVERTIME.DESC: Issue bulk overtime work orders per department or project with automated compliance-based overtime rate calculation.

DATABASE_MANAGEMENT.TITLE: Employee Database & Profiles
DATABASE_MANAGEMENT.DESC: Centralize employee master data, career milestones, contracts, vital documents, and org charts in a secure database.

EMPLOYEE_DATA_UPDATE.TITLE: Employee Self-Service (ESS)
EMPLOYEE_DATA_UPDATE.DESC: Empower employees to update personal details, bank accounts, emergency contacts, and family information independently.

PAYROLL.TITLE: Automated Payroll Calculation
PAYROLL.DESC: Automatically calculate base salary, allowances, statutory deductions, overtime, and bonuses with encrypted digital payslips.

PERSONAL_OVERTIME.TITLE: Personal Overtime Requests
PERSONAL_OVERTIME.DESC: Self-service overtime submission by employees with instant overtime pay estimations and direct supervisor approval.

YEARLY_TAX.TITLE: Yearly Tax & PPh 21 Calculation
YEARLY_TAX.DESC: Automate employee income tax (PPh 21/26) withholding calculations, Form 1721-A1 generation, and year-end reporting.
